description: Lab result whose source stated WHY the interpretation is missing, not merely that it is
notes: health v2.7. The value is present; the source's interpretationCode carried nullFlavor NASK, which maps to not-asked. v2.6 admitted only 'unknown' from the data-absent-reason code system, so NASK, ASKU and NAV all had to be flattened to 'unknown' and three different clinical facts became one. Putting a data-absent-reason coding into the CodeableConcept that is missing is FHIR's own idiom for an element absent for a stated reason. Measured RED against the pre-train spec pin, where 'not-asked' was outside the sh:in and this VALID record was rejected.
